title: The Night the Lights Went Out
text:
The television died first, then the lights, and then the hum of the refrigerator that nobody ever notices until it stops.
For a moment the flat was completely silent. Outside, the whole block had vanished into darkness, and for the first time in my life I could see stars above the rooftops.
My father found candles in a drawer. My mother boiled water on the gas stove, which still worked, and made tea nobody had asked for. We sat on the floor around a single flame, because there was nothing else to do.
And then my grandmother began to tell a story about a tiger that had wandered into her village when she was seven years old. My brother forgot to complain about his game. I forgot to be bored.
The power came back two hours later. Everybody groaned.
